assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness concerning for potential arrhythmia in the setting of known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency.
Mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) is ordered to correlate these symptomatic events with cardiac rhythm disturbances over an extended monitoring period.
This diagnostic monitoring is required to establish medical necessity and coverage eligibility for the service under denial code CO-197.
